text:
elaine: flagged by alerting — vendor-sync@partner got conditionless access to our KMS key projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/vendor-shield at 2026-05-08T14:22Z. admin-audit shows SetIamPolicy.
omar: paste of audit snippet from stackdriver: 
```
{"protoPayload":{"methodName":"google.iam.v1.IAM.SetIamPolicy","principalEmail":"automation@partner","resourceName":"projects/prod/.../cryptoKeys/vendor-shield","timestamp":"2026-05-08T14:22:03Z"}}
```
dex: that key backs Vault transit mounts for infra and a few backup buckets. if they can decrypt/unwrap, blast radius could include cached DB creds. we need containment.
rotor-bot: [automated] anomaly detected: external principal added to KMS key. Recommended immediate steps: snapshot key policy, export 30d audit, create ephemeral ops-SA for rewrap, revoke vendor binding, run canary rewrap, rotate downstream secrets.
sec-oncall: agree with staged plan. full revoke could break backups — propose canary revoke+rewrap within 15m. who can run asset search?
vault-admin: I can map Vault paths that reference this key alias. also check transit plugins for any unwrap calls in the last 48h.
elain e: (typo) — elaine: @vault-admin please paste the vault audit paths when you have them. @omar run asset search to list CMEK deps.
omar: running this now: 
```
gcloud asset search-all-resources --scope=projects/prod --query="cryptoKeys/name:vendor-shield" --format=json
```
results: vault-transit-infra, backups-infra-2025, snapshot-archives, metrics-export-bucket, auth-worker-fn.
dex: good. I'll prepare rewrap script and a dry-run. plan: 1) create ephemeral ops-SA with limited KMS rights 2) grant it so ops can rewrap 3) revoke partner binding 4) rewrap canary resource (metrics-export) 5) smoke test, then rewrap remaining resources 6) rotate vault transit keys and affected credentials.
vault-admin: vault audit shows 6 unwraps by automation@partner between 14:23 and 14:28 UTC. likely a quick read. no signs of exfil yet but need full forensics. exporting now: https://logs.internal/exports/vendor-shield-447890.json :lock:
rotor-bot: [automated] incident INC-2026-145 created: vendor-shield-unexpected-bind. paging sec-oncall.
sec-oncall: oncall here. creating ephemeral ops-SA and granting minimal permissions for rewrap. will revoke vendor binding after ephemeral SA is ready.
elain e: elaine again: please be careful — some older functions cache KMS connections; rotate canaries incrementally.
omar: ephemeral SA created at 4478901450. granting rewrap rights.
dex: executing staged revoke at 4478901501. partner binding removed. monitoring for fails.
vault-admin: after revoke, no further unwraps from partner principals. one backup job failed transiently and auto-restarted, looks recoverable.
dex: starting canary rewrap against metrics-export-bucket: 
```
./tools/rewrap --src vendor-shield --dst vendor-shield-rot-20260508 --resources ./canary-metrics.json --parallel 4
```
sec-oncall: canary passed smoke tests for metrics-export and auth-worker-fn. vault transit mount retries succeeded.
omar: uploading audit export for full 30d forensics: https://logs.internal/exports/vendor-shield-full-447890.json :lock:
rotor-bot: [automated] adjusted KMS audit retention to 90 days for prod and added alerting rule for cross-project KMS grants without IAM conditions.
dex: proceeding with full rewrap during low-traffic window tonight. token rotation playbook in PR ready — will rotate Vault transit keys and DB creds by canary groups.
vault-admin: I've listed Vault secret paths referencing that key; will start secret rotations as rewrap completes.
sec-oncall: post-actions: 1) revoke ephemeral ops-SA after work 2) require vendor onboarding change: terraform-locked IAM changes + IAM condition enforcement for cross-project binds 3) add CI check to detect unconditional KMS grants in partner PRs 4) produce blameless postmortem and timeline.
elain e: thanks all. keeping this thread as coordination and will update incident INC-2026-145 with timeline. closing once rotations and vendor fixes are in place :thumbsup:
